notes: run_ead_ccf_validation's _ccf_pop data-prep DATA step and its ccf_by_segment / ead_accuracy PROC SQL queries copied unmodified. The macro's first query (ccf_accuracy) also calls CORR(predicted_ccf, realized_ccf) as a plain PROC SQL aggregate expression -- CORR is not a documented PROC SQL summary function in SAS 9.4 (support.sas.com/documentation/cdl/en/sqlproc/62086/HTML/default/a001334120.htm lists AVG/MEAN/COUNT/FREQ/N/CSS/CV/MAX/MIN/NMISS/PRT/RANGE/STD/STDERR/SUM/SUMWGT/T/USS/VAR only, no CORR), so that query is left out of this bundle -- it's the repo's own construct, not something to route around by rewriting their code. Caller generates a small defaulted-loan portfolio with credit_limit/current_drawn/predicted_ccf, matching the shape main/generate_sample_data.sas produces for defaults.
